arguments.title: Save the requested fact privately in local gbrain and verify recall
arguments.command:
set -eu
export GBRAIN_NO_AUTOPILOT_INSTALL=1 GBRAIN_NO_REEMBED=1
gbrain remember "The user's sister's new cat is called Gamoufail." --entity user --provenance 'User directly stated this in chat' --content-origin user_said --visibility private
gbrain recall --grep Gamoufail
